summary: Copies the .claude folder into .agent and refreshes AGENTS.md from CLAUDE.md.
purpose: Keeps two agent setup folders matching one source.
why: Likely reason: the bootstrap workflow creates this same script so two tools can read the same instructions.
how: 1. Stops on any error. 2. Makes .agent match .claude, deleting extra files in .agent. 3. Copies CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md. 4. Prints a done message.
risks: The delete flag removes anything in .agent that is not in .claude, so manual edits there are lost. It must run from the project root or the paths will be wrong.
debug: If nothing changes, check that you ran it from the project root. If files vanish, that is the delete step, so restore them from git.
